name: Off The Record
source:
In this game, you'll be playing as a guy in his first years of adult life in all theirs uncertainty. First relationships, first breakups, multiple attempts of finding yourself — all that stuff.

After living for a few years together with your girlfriend, you decide to make a fresh start in a new city. There you'll bound to meet a lot of new people and experience different situations, from exciting to dreadful... 

[From Patreon[/url]]
